title: Beautiful slim table, but was missing 6 screws.
text:
Beautiful slim table, but was missing 6 screws.. This AZ L1 Life Concept Console table is perfect for your entryway. It’s beautiful, however was missing 6 of the 8 “C” screws, so I had to find my own and improvise. Once I got all of the needed parts, the assembly was easy.

The color of the table is nice and neutral, and it doesn’t take up much space width-wise. I just wish quality control checked it before shipping as I was missing some of the needed screws to assemble it.

If it had all of the needed parts, I would have given it 5 stars.
